title: Provider channel manifest — v1
description: Immutable provider artifact channel manifest. One file per channel under channels/<channel>.json; channels are data namespaces in this repo, not branches. Stage 1 is schema/data only: no runtime loading or activation. See docs/provider-channels.md for canonical digest semantics and the digestAlgorithm migration path.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL — optional, lets editors validate the file. Conventionally https://registry.adhf.dev/schemas/v1/channels/channel-manifest.schema.json.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Unknown versions are rejected (fail closed).

channel.description: Channel namespace. Must also match the filename channels/<channel>.json; absent or ambiguous channel data fails validation.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of manifest publication. Manifests are immutable once published; corrections ship as a new manifest version.

providers.description: Provider artifacts in this channel. providerType+providerVersion is unique within a channel.

providerType.description: Stable provider identifier. Matches the provider.json `type` field and the registry.json key. Lowercase kebab-case.

providerVersion.description: Provider package SemVer. Must equal the artifact manifest's providerVersion.

category.description: Provider category; determines the artifact directory <category>/<dir>/.

name.description: Human-readable name copied from the artifact manifest (informational).

bundleDigest.description: Canonical content digest of the provider bundle, lowercase hex sha256 with explicit algorithm prefix. The same canonical bundle yields exactly one digest across machines; anything not matching ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ is rejected.

digestAlgorithm.description: How the canonical digest input is constructed. Stage 1 uses 'adhdev-provider-tree-sha256-v1' (tracked provider directory tree; see docs/provider-channels.md). A later packaging stage will introduce a canonical-bundle algorithm; unknown algorithms fail closed.

compatibility.description: Compatibility bounds/metadata declared by the current provider artifact.

contractVersion.description: Typed contract version declared by the artifact, when present.

ideVersion.description: IDE/host SemVer ranges declared by the artifact's compatibility entries, deduplicated and sorted. Each must parse as a valid SemVer range.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp this entry was published to the channel.

promotedFrom.description: Optional provenance for promoted entries. Promotion copies the identical bundleDigest and never rebuilds: promotedFrom.bundleDigest must equal this entry's bundleDigest, and the source channel must differ from this manifest's channel.

channel.description: Source channel the artifact was promoted from (e.g. preview for a stable entry).

bundleDigest.description: Digest recorded in the source channel. Must equal this entry's bundleDigest.
